caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object in the shape of a dog standing on a rectangular base. The dog is shown in profile, facing left, and is colored in dark brown tones with lighter brown highlights, giving the appearance of a bronze or cast-iron material. The dog has short legs, a pronounced snout, and floppy ears. From the middle of the dog's back, an upward-curving tail extends, forming a large loop that arches over the animal, suggesting it may function as a handle or lever. The rectangular base on which the dog stands is also colored in shades of brown and is dotted with a series of small, evenly spaced circular depressions. The base bears the inscription "DOG THAT TUG GRAHAM," engraved or embossed in capital letters and running parallel to the length of the base. The background is a plain, light beige color, with no additional objects or patterns present.
title: Nutcracker: Dog Tray
